title: Asa's Reformation

questions.question: Upon whom did the Spirit of God come?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:1 (ESV): "The Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded..."

questions.question: What principle did Azariah state to Asa?
options: The LORD is with you while you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you
God helps those who help themselves
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD is with you while you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:2 (ESV): "...The LORD is with you while you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you..."

questions.question: What happens if you forsake God?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:2 (ESV): "...but if you forsake him, he will forsake you."

questions.question: What did Asa do when he heard these words?
options: He took courage and put away the detestable idols
questions.correctAnswer: He took courage and put away the detestable idols
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:8 (ESV): "...he took courage and put away the detestable idols from all the land of Judah and Benjamin..."

questions.question: Why did Asa remove Maacah from being queen mother?
options: Because she had made an abominable image for Asherah
questions.correctAnswer: Because she had made an abominable image for Asherah
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:16 (ESV): "Even Maacah, his mother, King Asa removed from being queen mother because she had made an abominable image for Asherah."

questions.question: How was the situation in Israel for a long time described?
options: Without the true God and without a teaching priest and without law
questions.correctAnswer: Without the true God and without a teaching priest and without law
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:3 (ESV): "For a long time Israel was without the true God, and without a teaching priest and without law."

questions.question: What did Azariah encourage Asa to do?
options: Be strong and do not let your hands be weak, for your work shall be rewarded
questions.correctAnswer: Be strong and do not let your hands be weak, for your work shall be rewarded
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:7 (ESV): "But you, take courage! Do not let your hands be weak, for your work shall be rewarded."

questions.question: What did Asa do with the altar of the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:8 (ESV): "...and he repaired the altar of the LORD that was in front of the vestibule of the LORD."

questions.question: Who gathered to Asa?
options: All Judah and Benjamin, and those from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon
questions.correctAnswer: All Judah and Benjamin, and those from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:9 (ESV): "And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon..."

questions.question: In what year of Asa's reign did they gather at Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:10 (ESV): "They were gathered at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa."

questions.question: What covenant did they enter into?
options: To seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul
questions.correctAnswer: To seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:12 (ESV): "And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD... with all their heart and with all their soul..."

questions.question: What was the penalty for not seeking the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:13 (ESV): "but that whoever would not seek the LORD... should be put to death..."

questions.question: How did they take the oath?
options: With a loud voice and with shouting and with trumpets and with horns
questions.correctAnswer: With a loud voice and with shouting and with trumpets and with horns
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:14 (ESV): "They swore an oath to the LORD with a loud voice and with shouting and with trumpets and with horns."

questions.question: What was the result of their oath and seeking God?
options: The LORD gave them rest all around
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD gave them rest all around
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:15 (ESV): "...and he was found by them, and the LORD gave them rest all around."

questions.question: Were the high places taken out of Israel?
options: No, nevertheless the heart of Asa was wholly true all his days
questions.correctAnswer: No, nevertheless the heart of Asa was wholly true all his days
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 15:17 (ESV): "But the high places were not taken out of Israel. Nevertheless, the heart of Asa was wholly true all his days."

key_verse_text: But you, take courage! Do not let your hands be weak, for your work shall be rewarded.
